product_overview: PixiBun Atelier is an offline-first pixel art studio for drawing, animating, and exporting sprites directly in the browser. It combines a landing page entry point with a full studio workspace for raster editing, palette control, layer management, timeline animation, and file export.
core_goals: Enter the studio from the landing page
Create and edit pixel art on a canvas using drawing tools
Manage colors through palettes and swatches
Animate artwork across frames on a timeline
Export finished artwork in common image and project formats

features.name: Landing Page Navigation
features.description: The public landing page introduces PixiBun and provides a path into the studio workspace.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View the product overview and feature highlights -> Open the studio workspace -> See the /studio editor
Navigate to / -> Review the showcased capabilities -> Open the studio workspace -> Begin working in the editor

features.name: Canvas Drawing Suite
features.description: The studio canvas supports pixel-level drawing, erasing, line and shape creation, fill tools, color replacement, dithering, eyedropper sampling, and symmetry or mirror drawing modes.
user_flows: Navigate to /studio -> Select a drawing tool -> Draw on the canvas -> Refine pixels with erasing or line and shape tools -> See the artwork update on the canvas
Navigate to /studio -> Choose flood fill or color replace -> Click a region on the canvas -> See the selected area change to the chosen color
Navigate to /studio -> Select the eyedropper tool -> Sample a color from the canvas -> Continue drawing with the sampled color
Navigate to /studio -> Enable symmetry or mirror mode -> Draw on one side of the canvas -> See the opposite side update symmetrically

features.name: Palette and Swatches
features.description: The studio provides preset palettes, custom swatches, primary and secondary color selection, and ramp generation for managing artwork colors.
user_flows: Navigate to /studio -> Select a swatch in the palette bar -> Set the active drawing color -> Continue painting with the new color
Navigate to /studio -> Choose primary and secondary colors -> Swap between them while drawing -> See the active color change for subsequent strokes
Navigate to /studio -> Add a new custom swatch -> Generate a color ramp -> See additional palette steps appear in the palette bar
Navigate to /studio -> Switch to a preset palette -> Continue drawing with the preset colors -> See the active palette change

features.name: Layer Stack Management
features.description: The studio layer panel lets users add, reorder, hide, lock, and adjust the opacity of layers to build complex artwork.
user_flows: Navigate to /studio -> Add a new layer -> Draw on the new layer -> See the artwork separated across layers
Navigate to /studio -> Reorder layers in the stack -> Observe the composited artwork change -> Continue editing with the new order
Navigate to /studio -> Toggle a layer's visibility -> See that layer appear or disappear in the composition -> Continue working
Navigate to /studio -> Lock a layer -> Attempt to draw on it -> See that the layer remains protected
Navigate to /studio -> Adjust a layer's opacity -> Observe the transparency change in the composition -> Continue editing

features.name: Animation Timeline
features.description: The timeline supports frame creation, duplication, playback control, FPS adjustment, onion skinning, and frame reordering or deletion for sprite animation.
user_flows: Navigate to /studio -> Add a frame -> Draw the next animation state -> See the timeline grow with additional frames
Navigate to /studio -> Duplicate the current frame -> Edit the duplicate -> Compare the two frames in the timeline
Navigate to /studio -> Play the animation -> Observe frame playback -> Pause the animation
Navigate to /studio -> Adjust playback FPS -> Play the animation again -> Observe the timing change
Navigate to /studio -> Toggle onion skinning -> Move between frames -> See ghosted neighboring frames for alignment
Navigate to /studio -> Reorder or delete frames -> See the animation sequence update in the timeline

features.name: Export Modal
features.description: The export dialog lets users save artwork as PNG, GIF, spritesheets, or project JSON with configurable scale and format options.
user_flows: Navigate to /studio -> Open the export dialog -> Select PNG export -> Choose a scale factor -> Download the image file
Navigate to /studio -> Open the export dialog -> Select GIF export -> Choose the desired scale factor -> Download the animated file
Navigate to /studio -> Open the export dialog -> Select spritesheet export -> Download the packed sheet and metadata
Navigate to /studio -> Open the export dialog -> Select project JSON export -> Download the project data file
